findings.title: revealIssue resets to the sentinel and hides the row it promised to show
findings.fix: When the revealed row fails the current filters, revealIssue now sets filters to {...EMPTY_FILTERS, client: row.issue.client} and says so in the toast; a row carrying no client gets an error toast naming the next action instead of a false 'visible'. Inside the ui workstream; the general Clear and reveal semantics (recorded choice, scoped-All, refusal outside memberProjectIdsFor) remain step 10, blocked on OQ8.

findings.title: data/validation.json is committed but is outside every workstream's owns list
findings.fix: Not fixable inside the plan. The file is written by scripts/scenario-validation.ts on every run, so the verify commands of steps 2, 4 and 9 regenerate it, and the scenario-testing skill and proof-orchestrator treat it as the committed baseline diffed against master; dropping it from the commits would contradict that, and adding it to an owns list is widening ownership in place, which build-orchestrator.md forbids. Resolution is the planner's: version 3 of ART-20260905-017 adds data/validation.json to the proof workstream (or records that gate-runner output travels with the change), after which this file entry reads 'proof'. Until then the entry is marked 'unowned' here so the proof-orchestrator's step 1 check sees it rather than a workstream the plan never granted.

findings.title: The UI resting sentinel is persisted into shared saved views before its fate is decided
findings.fix: onSaveCurrentView in components/IssueWorkspace.tsx refuses to dispatch upsertSavedView while filters.client is NO_CLIENT_CHOSEN, with a toast naming the next action, so the sentinel never reaches state.model.savedViews. This is a guard inside the ui workstream, not the decision step 6 (blocked on OQ8) owns: lib/workspace.ts and lib/savedViews.ts are untouched, and whether the sentinel is excluded on save or defined on apply is still to be fixed there. The stale 'degrade to broader' docblock in lib/savedViews.ts is noted for step 6.
